# Pine Forest Berry

Pine Forest Berry is a minimal dark and light theme with a calm color palette. It revises code block rendering, tag visibility in light mode, menu contrast and navigation, and it supports adjustable font sizes and alternative checkboxes.

![Pine Forest Berry screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nilahn/pine_forest_berry/HEAD/Screenshot%20PFB%201.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Pine Forest Berry"
    author: "nilahn"
    repo:   "nilahn/pine_forest_berry"
    slug:   "pine-forest-berry"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/pine-forest-berry"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nilahn/pine_forest_berry"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nilahn/pine_forest_berry/HEAD/Screenshot%20PFB%201.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal dark and light Obsidian theme with a calm, aesthetic color palette. Improve code block rendering, tag visibility in light mode, menu contrast and navigation, and support adjustable font sizes plus alternative checkboxes."
}
```
